description: Defines the StepperMotor class for controlling a stepper motor, including initialization, movement commands, and configuration parameters.

classes.name: StepperMotor
classes.description: Class encapsulating control and configuration of a stepper motor, including target position management and GPIO pin handling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up GPIO pins, logging, reaction time, step count, and enables the motor.

methods.name: pulse
methods.description: Sends a pulse to move the stepper motor one step.

methods.name: setTargetPosition
methods.description: Sets the desired position for the motor to reach.

methods.name: getTargetPosition
methods.description: Returns the current target position of the motor.
